title: BandStrong 8: Full-Body Strength & Hypertrophy
author: Kwame Aduansere
desc:
BandStrong 8 is an 8-week, AI-curated resistance band training programme designed to build muscle, improve strength, enhance muscular endurance, and support fat loss.
The programme brings together selected full-body resistance band workouts from established YouTube fitness channels, including ACHV PEAK, HASfit, and Fitness KayKay.
Using AI-assisted curation, these workouts have been evaluated, selected, and organised into a structured training programme based on exercise variety, muscle-group coverage, progressive overload, and training efficiency.
